title: Sheet-metal flat-pattern DXF export
summary: Export a sheet-metal part's flat pattern as a layered DXF (CUT / BEND_UP / BEND_DOWN, in millimetres) ready to send to a laser bureau.
details:
## What's New

- **`flat_pattern_to_dxf`** in `vcad-kernel-sheet`: serialises a `FlatPattern` to DXF R12 with the manufacturing layer convention from the design spec — `CUT` (red) for panel outlines + holes, `BEND_UP` (blue) and `BEND_DOWN` (cyan) for creases. Units are millimetres so geometry imports true-scale.
- Threaded through the WASM binding and engine glue: the DXF rides along with the flat pattern in a single boundary call (no extra round-trip).
- **Download DXF** button in the sheet-metal panel.

This closes the last gap in the sheet-metal foundation tier.
